note: The submitted bytes become the SIP message buffer used by the parser.
After the start line is parsed, the unparsed header pointer is set into the input-controlled header block.
Header parsing advances through the Via header and then calls get_hdr_field for the input-controlled Content-Length header, with end equal to the end of the candidate buffer.
The Content-Length header value is delegated to parse_content_length while the value buffer ends immediately after a trailing space.
The parser consumes trailing linear whitespace up to end but does not ensure there is a byte available before taking the error path.
For a Content-Length value ending in a space, p equals end and the log message dereferences *p one byte past the candidate buffer.
